items.statement: The investigation defines and tests explicit hypotheses about surface versus bulk Ga incorporation rather than assuming a published route.
items.expected: At least two plausible hypotheses and discriminating calculations are recorded.

items.statement: Surface candidates are uniquely identified, deduplicated, composition-audited and validated with convergence evidence.
items.expected: Per-candidate identity and validation context are retained through the reported selection.

items.statement: The thermodynamic reference and chemical-potential construction are explicitly defined using β-Ga2O3, H2 and H2O, with solid entropy treatment stated.
items.expected: The method record allows an independent reader to reconstruct the energy balance.

items.statement: The reaction-point analysis supports nonzero Cu(111) surface-alloy relevance/onset in the model.
items.expected: The conclusion is supported by the submitted reaction-point coverage and candidate comparison, or a scientifically justified bounded interval.

items.statement: Bulk alloying is less favorable at the reaction point and becomes relevant only under more reducing/high-temperature conditions in the modeled comparison.
items.expected: The bulk comparison explicitly contrasts the reaction point with the high-temperature bulk regime.
